title: Medtrum : PasswordReset doesn't work
symptom: After force closing AAPS and creating a PasswordReset file in aaps/extra, starting AAPS and config wizard, entering the pump base serial results in 'wrong password'. The file stays on dev but gets deleted on master.
cause: The password reset file content was being interpreted as uppercase, but it should be lowercase.
fix: The fix is to make the password reset file content lowercase. A commit was made to change it to lowercase, and the user confirmed that lowercase works.
evidence_quote: it should work. It's in lowercase
